scope.age_policy: Birth through the second birthday, inclusive; not the entire completed 24th month.
scope.purpose: Source-backed conversational support for everyday baby care, development and reviewed health education.
boundaries: No diagnosis, prescribing, medicine doses or individualized vaccine catch-up plans.
Recognised urgent symptoms require referral before routine generation; the system is not comprehensive emergency assessment.
Relevant but unsupported questions need clarification, a clear reference limitation or an appropriate next step, not fabricated advice.

required_review_fields: original URL and PDF page or web section
publication/update date where available and date checked
practical explanations and examples where supported
precautions and professional-referral boundaries where relevant

topics: preparing questions for a clinic visit
expected side effects and warning signs
professional assessment of missed vaccines or individual reactions
developmental concerns and loss of skills
feeding and routines away from home
when travel health questions require a clinic
caregiver wellbeing in everyday baby care

completion_policy: A topic is not complete because it has a passage or tag. Review age applicability, source support, useful responses and follow-ups, missing-evidence behaviour, safety, latency and end-to-end delivery. Health content requires qualified review before activation. No claim of covering every possible baby-care situation.
